# Dockio

> Dockio Technosolutions Private Limited is an enterprise AI transformation and systems-integration company based in Mumbai, India. Dockio is an OpenAI Select Partner.

We connect business priorities, enterprise systems and people to build useful AI capabilities and evidence of value. Our primary focus is banking and financial services, with services for insurance, global capability centres, life sciences and consumer businesses.

## Services
- [AI strategy and value design](https://www.dockio.in/services/ai-strategy-value/)
- [Agentic AI and enterprise integration](https://www.dockio.in/services/agentic-ai-integration/)
- [ChatGPT and Codex enablement](https://www.dockio.in/services/chatgpt-codex-enablement/)
- [AI governance, evaluation and operations](https://www.dockio.in/services/governance-evaluation/)
- [Embedded AI delivery and specialist teams](https://www.dockio.in/services/embedded-ai-teams/)
- [Data, analytics and customer intelligence](https://www.dockio.in/services/data-customer-intelligence/)

## BudgetOps
- [BudgetOps](https://www.dockio.in/budgetops/): A platform in development for preparing AI investment proposals, examining assumptions and cost scenarios, and organising supporting evidence. Design-partner conversations are open. It is not a generally available product.

- [Book a conversation](https://www.dockio.in/book/)
